simpleoptrender.guide.page.1.title: Simple Opt Render
simpleoptrender.guide.page.1: Client optimizations; each area steps back when a known optimization mod covers it.
simpleoptrender.guide.page.2.title: Steps back for known mods
simpleoptrender.guide.page.2: Each area has a mode in config/simpleoptrender.json: auto (default), ours, theirs or off. In auto, a known mod for the same area wins and our part stays off:
simpleoptrender.guide.page.3.title: Steps back for known mods
simpleoptrender.guide.page.3: Cull Leaves, More Culling or Sodium for leaf culling, BadOptimizations for the light map, More Culling for more culling, Sodium Extra for the detail switches, Fast IP Ping, No Telemetry.
simpleoptrender.guide.page.4.title: Steps back for known mods
simpleoptrender.guide.page.4: Ours next to such a mod is refused when both would hook the same code. The decision is made at game start (restart after a change) and logged as one table; we never switch another mod off. Target check:
simpleoptrender.guide.page.5.title: Steps back for known mods
simpleoptrender.guide.page.5: when any other mod (not ours, not Fabric API) hooks one of the classes an area changes, that area switches itself off at start and the log names the mod as a possible conflict;
simpleoptrender.guide.page.6.title: Steps back for known mods
simpleoptrender.guide.page.6: mode ours keeps it on, conflictScan false skips the check.
simpleoptrender.guide.page.7.title: Leaf culling
simpleoptrender.guide.page.7: Leaves no longer draw the faces they share with other leaves, so forests build smaller chunk meshes while the outside keeps the fancy cutout look. A face next to air or any other block always stays, so no hole opens.
simpleoptrender.guide.page.8.title: Leaf culling
simpleoptrender.guide.page.8: depth (0 to 4, default 0) keeps the faces seen through the outer layers: with depth 1 only faces behind two leaf layers are left out.
simpleoptrender.guide.page.9.title: Light map cache
simpleoptrender.guide.page.9: The light map is only uploaded again when one of its inputs (sky and block light, gamma, effects, boss darkening, colors) moved by at least half a color step since the last upload;
simpleoptrender.guide.page.10.title: Light map cache
simpleoptrender.guide.page.10: smaller changes cannot change a pixel, so the picture stays identical.
simpleoptrender.guide.page.11.title: Fast IP ping
simpleoptrender.guide.page.11: A server address typed as a plain IP (IPv4, or IPv6 in brackets) is used as it is:
simpleoptrender.guide.page.12.title: Fast IP ping
simpleoptrender.guide.page.12: no reverse DNS lookup and no SRV query, so the server list fills faster. Names still resolve the Vanilla way.
simpleoptrender.guide.page.13.title: Telemetry off
simpleoptrender.guide.page.13: The client never starts a telemetry session: every telemetry event goes to the Vanilla disabled sender, nothing is sent.
simpleoptrender.guide.page.14.title: More culling
simpleoptrender.guide.page.14: Three more things are left out when they cannot be seen, each with its own switch (all on): signText drops the text side facing away from you once you stand more than half a block behind the board;
simpleoptrender.guide.page.15.title: More culling
simpleoptrender.guide.page.15: itemFrames skips frames (with item or map) seen from behind their solid wall, frames with the Glowing effect stay; beaconBeams skips beacon beams outside the view.
simpleoptrender.guide.page.16.title: Detail switches
simpleoptrender.guide.page.16: Switches without needing Sodium, all true (Vanilla) by default:
simpleoptrender.guide.page.17.title: Detail switches
simpleoptrender.guide.page.17: particles false adds no particles, textureAnimations false keeps animated textures (water, lava, fire, portals) on their current frame, fog false lifts the air and render-distance fog.
simpleoptrender.guide.page.18.title: Detail switches
simpleoptrender.guide.page.18: Fog in water, lava or powder snow and the fog of blindness and darkness always stay.
simpleoptrender.guide.page.19.title: Commands
simpleoptrender.guide.page.19: /simpleclient simpleoptrender shows and changes every option of config/simpleoptrender.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simpleoptrender.guide.page.20.title: Commands
simpleoptrender.guide.page.20: The file is read once while the game starts, so a change is saved at once but takes effect after a restart (each answer says so). A client command, no permission needed (singleplayer and servers alike).
